   - bash /tmp/flash_ai_agent_nsh.sh /dev/ttyACM0
   - If stub timeout: RTS pulse, retry sftool with --compat
3. Capture: flash exit code, NSH prompt, help/ai_agent in output
4. If still NO_CH343 after poll: report clearly

input.command:
bash <<'POLLFLASH'
set -u
POLL_MAX=90
INTERVAL=3
FOUND=0
elapsed=0
while [ "$elapsed" -lt "$POLL_MAX" ]; do
  if lsusb -d 1a86:55d3 2>/dev/null | grep -q . && [ -e /dev/ttyACM0 ]; then
    FOUND=1
    echo "CH343_FOUND at ${elapsed}s: $(lsusb -d 1a86:55d3 2>/dev/null | head -1)"
    ls -la /dev/ttyACM0
    break
  fi
  echo "poll ${elapsed}s: NO_CH343 or no ttyACM0"
  sleep "$INTERVAL"
  elapsed=$((elapsed + INTERVAL))
done

if [ "$FOUND" -ne 1 ]; then
  echo "RESULT=NO_CH343_AFTER_${POLL_MAX}s"
  lsusb 2>/dev/null | grep -i ch343 || lsusb 2>/dev/null | grep 1a86 || true
  ls -la /dev/ttyACM* 2>/dev/null || echo "no ttyACM devices"
  exit 2
fi

fuser -k /dev/ttyACM0 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 0.3

python3 - <<'PY'
import serial, time
s=serial.Serial("/dev/ttyACM0", 1000000, timeout=0.2)
s.dtr=False; s.rts=False; time.sleep(0.1); s.close()
print("RTS/DTR deasserted")
PY

BIN=/home/a1/openvela/cmake_out/sf32lb52_devkit_lcd_ai_agent/nuttx.bin
PORT=/dev/ttyACM0
FLASH_EC=0
FLASH_LOG=/tmp/flash_run_$$.log

run_sftool() {
  local extra=("$@")
  sftool -c SF32LB52 -p "$PORT" "${extra[@]}" write_flash --verify "${BIN}@0x12010000" 2>&1 | tee -a "$FLASH_LOG"
  return "${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
}

: > "$FLASH_LOG"
echo "=== sftool attempt 1 (normal) ==="
if ! run_sftool; then
  FLASH_EC=$?
  if grep -qiE 'stub|timeout|Timed out' "$FLASH_LOG"; then
    echo "=== stub/timeout detected, RTS pulse + --compat retry ==="
    python3 - <<'PY'
import serial, time
s=serial.Serial("/dev/ttyACM0", 1000000, timeout=0.2)
s.rts=True; time.sleep(0.05); s.rts=False; time.sleep(0.2); s.dtr=False; s.close()
print("RTS pulse done")
PY
    sleep 0.5
    echo "=== sftool attempt 2 (--compat) ==="
    if run_sftool --compat; then
      FLASH_EC=0
    else
      FLASH_EC=$?
    fi
  fi
fi

echo "FLASH_EXIT_CODE=$FLASH_EC"

NSH_LOG=/tmp/nsh_run_$$.log
python3 - <<'PY' | tee "$NSH_LOG"
import serial, time, sys
port="/dev/ttyACM0"
s=serial.Serial(port, 1000000, timeout=1)
s.dtr=False; s.rts=False
time.sleep(0.3)
s.reset_input_buffer()
s.write(b"\r\nhelp\r\n")
time.sleep(1.0)
s.write(b"ai_agent ?\r\n")
time.sleep(0.5)
data=s.read(4096).decode(errors="replace")
s.close()
print("--- NSH OUTPUT ---")
print(data)
ok = "nsh>" in data
has_help = "help" in data.lower() or "usage" in data.lower()
has_ai = "ai_agent" in data
print("--- CHECKS ---")
print(f"nsh_prompt={ok}")
print(f"help_in_output={has_help}")
print(f"ai_agent_in_output={has_ai}")
print("NSH_OK" if ok else "NSH_FAIL")
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
NSH_EC=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo "NSH_EXIT_CODE=$NSH_EC"

# Also try flash script for comparison if sftool succeeded
if [ "$FLASH_EC" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Flash succeeded via sftool path above."
else
  echo "=== fallback: flash_ai_agent_nsh.sh ==="
  set +e
  bash /tmp/flash_ai_agent_nsh.sh /dev/ttyACM0 2>&1 | tee /tmp/flash_script_fallback.log
  SCRIPT_EC=$?
  set -e
  echo "SCRIPT_EXIT_CODE=$SCRIPT_EC"
  if [ "$SCRIPT_EC" -eq 0 ]; then FLASH_EC=0; fi
fi

exit $(( FLASH_EC != 0 ? FLASH_EC : NSH_EC ))
POLLFLASH
echo "OVERALL_EXIT=$?"
